title: TensorPlate Error
description: Typed error payload shared by C++ runtime, Rust agent/CLI/observability, and the Python sidecar backend. Mirrors include/tensorplate/core/error.hpp::Error.

schema_version.description: Schema family version. Decoders MUST reject unknown values with Error::Code::Unsupported.

code.description: Stable error code. The numeric C++ enum value is NOT part of the wire protocol; only these strings are.

context.description: Optional additional context (file path, request id, backend detail).
